list.title: Catalogue
list.intro: Goods and services Procurement keeps, with their reference prices and the prices agreed with suppliers. All prices are before VAT.
list.forbidden: This account may not view the catalogue yet. Contact your organization's administrator.

filter.label: Search the catalogue
filter.clear: Clear the search and see every item
filter.limited: Showing the first {shown}. Narrow the search to see the others.

list.emptyNone: The catalogue has no items yet
list.emptyNoneOther: Procurement adds the items. Meanwhile, type what you need in your request.
list.emptyNoneManage: Add the first item with “Add item” on the catalogue management page.
list.emptyNoMatchHint: Try other words or part of a code. If it is not in the catalogue, type what you need in your request.

manage.title: Manage the catalogue
manage.intro: Add and edit items and set the prices agreed with suppliers. Every change is recorded for audit. All prices are before VAT.
manage.forbidden: Only Procurement manages the catalogue and its agreed prices. See the items and prices on the catalogue page.
manage.endLabel: End the agreed price with {supplier} for {name}
manage.emptyNoMatchHint: Try other words or part of a code, or add a new item.

item.intro: Requesters see the name, unit and reference price when they choose this item in a request.
item.codeHint: Capital letters, digits, - or _, for example CEM-01. Set once; it cannot be changed later.
item.categoryHint: The category reviewer conditions use, for example CEMENT
item.refUnitPrice: Reference price per unit (baht, before VAT)
item.activeHint: Out of use, the item no longer shows in searches and request forms. Requests that already have it do not change.

agreement.title: Add an agreed price for {name}
agreement.intro: An agreed price is before VAT. Requests that suggest this supplier take this price and cannot change it during the period.
agreement.noSuppliers: The register has no active supplier yet. Add one on the suppliers page first.
agreement.validFromHint: Applies from the start of this day
agreement.lastDayHint: Applies until the end of this day

end.title: End the agreed price with {supplier}?
end.text: This price applies until the end of today ({today}). From tomorrow, requests for {name} that suggest this supplier no longer take it. This cannot be undone: to use a price again, add a new agreed price.

errors.CODE_EXISTS: This code is in the catalogue already. Use another code.
errors.CODE: Use capital letters, digits, - or _, at most 40 characters, for example CEM-01.
errors.NAME: Enter the Thai name.
errors.PRICE: Enter the price as a number with at most 2 decimals, for example 180 or 1,250.50.
errors.PRICE_ZERO: An agreed price must be above 0.
errors.NO_CHANGE: Nothing has changed. Change a value before saving.
errors.AGREEMENT_OVERLAP: These days overlap an agreed price this supplier already has. Choose days that do not overlap, or end the earlier price first.
errors.INVALID_PERIOD: The last day cannot be before the first day.
errors.PERIOD_OVER: These days are over already. Choose a last day from today on.
errors.SUPPLIER_UNKNOWN: This supplier is out of use or not in the register. Choose another supplier.
errors.AGREEMENT_NOT_STARTED: This price has not started yet, so it cannot be ended.
errors.AGREEMENT_OVER: This price ends today or tomorrow already. Reload the page to see where it stands.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This account may not manage the catalogue.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item is no longer found. Reload the page to see the latest items.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and try again.
errors.BUSY: The system is still working on the same command. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came from the system. Check your connection and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Tell your administrator the reference {requestId}.
errors.INPUT: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.FAILED: It could not be saved. Try again.
